rca of the issue: POST /api/rewards/redeem returned HTTP 500 with 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. Root cause: after `db.rewards.insert_one(redemption)` the pymongo driver mutates the input dict to add the generated `_id` (ObjectId). Code then returned the same dict; FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId → ValueError. Fix: call `redemption.pop('_id', None)` before returning. Mitigation: audit every `db.X.insert_one(d); return d` site for the same leak.
